name: smwmusic-lovers-of-aether-tutorial-session
title: Lovers of Aether - Tutorial Session
description:
A rather short and chill track from Lovers of Aether, originally ported as my entry for the 120hoSPC #8 which won 1st place. Good for plenty different calm settings.

NOTE: For this to insert properly, copy the provided sample group to the Addmusic_sample groups.txt file in your AMK folder. Not compatible w/ Blarggs/thunders.
